title: ACM Automates Public TLS
description: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) now supports the ACME protocol, enabling automated issuance and renewal of public TLS certificates. This update simplifies certificate management for developers, allowing any ACMEv2 client to manage certificates across all workloads. It also enhances governance with centralized controls and reduces operational risk, especially with increasingly shorter certificate lifetimes.
